category_description: Saving, investing and protecting your money in the United States.
subcategory_description: The limits and rules for IRAs and workplace retirement plans.
label: 401(k) employee elective deferral limit
context: For employees in 401(k), 403(b), and governmental 457 plans and the federal Thrift Savings Plan.

label: 401(k) catch-up contribution limit, age 50 and over
context: Generally applies to employees aged 50 and over in most 401(k), 403(b), governmental 457 plans and the Thrift Savings Plan.

label: Higher catch-up limit, ages 60 to 63
context: Under SECURE 2.0, employees aged 60, 61, 62 and 63 in these plans have this higher catch-up limit instead of the standard one.

label: SIMPLE retirement account contribution limit
context: The amount individuals can generally contribute to their SIMPLE retirement accounts.

label: SIMPLE limit for certain applicable plans
context: SECURE 2.0 allows a higher amount in certain applicable SIMPLE retirement accounts.

label: SIMPLE catch-up contribution limit, age 50 and over
context: Generally applies to employees aged 50 and over in most SIMPLE plans.

subject_intro: How much an employee can contribute to a 401(k), 403(b), 457, or Thrift Savings Plan, the catch-up amounts for older workers, and SIMPLE plan limits.
subject_meta_description: Employees can defer up to {fact:us_401k_limit} into a 401(k) in {tax_year}, plus catch-up amounts. See the matching limits for 403(b), 457, TSP, and SIMPLE plans.
